title: AI Assessments
summary: Technical, aptitude and cognitive tests that grade themselves against your bar.
headline: Tests that *grade themselves* against your bar
lede: Send calibrated assessments the moment a candidate is shortlisted. Results come back graded against the standard your team set, with the working shown.

capabilities.title: Technical Assessments
capabilities.body: Role-specific tasks for engineering, data, finance and operations roles, built from a question library or your own material.
points: Bring your own tasks and marking scheme

capabilities.title: Aptitude Assessments
capabilities.body: Numerical, verbal and logical reasoning tests for roles where potential matters more than history.
points: Benchmarked against the role, not the whole population
Suited to campus and volume hiring

capabilities.title: Cognitive Tests
capabilities.body: Measure problem solving, attention and learning speed with tasks that adapt as the candidate answers.
points: Accessible versions for candidates who need them

capabilities.title: Behavioral Analysis
capabilities.body: Situational judgement scenarios that show how a candidate would handle the moments your role really involves.
points: Scored on the response, never on appearance or voice
Results map to interview follow-up questions

capabilities.title: Automated Evaluation
capabilities.body: Answers are marked against your rubric in seconds, and every mark links back to the line of the rubric it came from.
points: Reviewers can override any mark, with a note
Results sync to the pipeline and your ATS

outcomes.label: candidates sit tests when it suits them
